messages.subject: reshape: problem when setting (value=)?
parts:
Hi

Just exploring pkg reshape, found something unexpected:

library(reshape)

#works
smithsm <- melt(smiths)
cast(smithsm, ... ~ variable)

#does not work:
smithsm2 <-rename(smithsm , c(value="value2"))
colnames(smithsm2)
cast(smithsm2, ... ~ variable)

#even if setting value manually, is problem:
cast(smithsm2, ... ~ variable, value="value2")

Do I do something wrong, or is there indeed an error?

Thanks!!

Matthieu
